name: Meal prep workflow
pitch: Design a weekly meal prep plan for two people with different dietary goals, fitting around their schedules.
instructions: Start by asking the person to list each person's dietary goals and any foods they avoid. Use web_search to find recipes that match each goal. When recipes are found, make_page a weekly meal plan page that shows breakfast, lunch and dinner for each person on each day. Add the meal plan to the calendar using calendar_create so both people see it. Create task items for shopping and cooking on the days set aside for prep. If a recipe search returns no results, say so and ask if they want to broaden the goals or try different foods. At the end, show_table the meal plan and the task list so the person can approve or change anything before it is saved.
starters: What are the two dietary goals?
Do either of you have foods you cannot eat?
Which days work best for shopping and cooking?

examples.ask: I need a meal prep plan for me and my partner.
examples.does: The agent searches for recipes, makes a weekly plan page, adds it to the calendar and creates shopping tasks.

skills.name: build-meal-plan
skills.description: Create a week of meals for two people with different diets.
skills.body: 1. Ask the person for each goal and any avoid foods. 2. web_search for recipes that fit each goal. 3. make_page a table with seven rows (one per day) and columns for each person's breakfast, lunch and dinner. 4. calendar_create the plan so both calendars show the meals. 5. task_create for buying ingredients and cooking on prep day. 6. If no recipes match, tell the person and ask if they want to change the goals.

rules.name: ask before adding calendar events
rules.description: The agent must wait for the person to agree before adding any event to their calendar.

rules.name: ask before writing files
rules.description: The agent must wait for the person to agree before writing the meal plan to a file.

readme:
# Meal prep workflow
Design a weekly meal prep plan for two people with different dietary goals, fitting around their schedules.

What it does: searches for recipes, builds a shared meal plan, adds it to the calendar and creates shopping and cooking tasks.
What it needs: web_search to find recipes, make_page to layout the plan, calendar_create to add it to their calendars, task_create for chores, file_write to save the plan (ask first).
What it will not do: it will not force a diet on anyone, it will not buy groceries or cook the food, and it will not add anything to the calendar without permission.
